records.text: A political source alleged that a freelance operative was positioned in advance to record Erika Kirk at an exact place and time, coordinated with digital-media teams, and intentionally distributed the staged moment to make it go viral
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep FFQ9675oqRI)

appearances.snippet: Apparently this freelancing operative was positioned in advance with the specific instruction to take that exact video at that exact place at that exact time. ... The operative was allegedly in communication with digital media teams and the entire moment was staged, captured, and then intended. ... intentionally shared amongst those digital media teams and their operatives whereupon it was made to go viral.

verification.notes: Current coverage reports that Candace Owens relayed this anonymous political-operative allegation, but also states that she supplied no inspectable material establishing advance positioning, digital-team coordination, or intentional viral distribution. The source remains anonymous and the allegation is not independently corroborated.
